verses.text: The number of people on the earth began to grow, and daughters were born to them.
The sons of God saw that these human daughters were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.
Then the LORD said, "My Spirit will not stay in human beings for ever, because they are mortal. Their life will last no more than a hundred and twenty years."

In those days, and also later, there were giants on the earth called the Nephilim. They came from the sons of God sleeping with human daughters, who had children by them. They were the mighty heroes of long ago, famous men.
The LORD saw how wicked people on the earth had become. Everything they thought about and planned in their hearts was always evil.
The LORD was sorry that he had made human beings on the earth, and it filled his heart with pain.

So the LORD said, "I will wipe out the people I have created from the face of the earth, and the animals, the creatures that move along the ground, and the birds in the sky. I am sorry that I have made them."
But Noah pleased the LORD.
This is the story of Noah and his family. Noah was a good man who did what was right. Among the people of his time, no one could find fault with him. He walked closely with God.
Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
In God's eyes the earth was rotten with sin, and it was full of violence.
God saw how corrupt the earth had become, because all the people on earth had turned to evil ways.
So God said to Noah, "I am going to put an end to all people, because the earth is full of violence because of them. I am going to destroy them together with the earth.
Build yourself a big boat, an ark, out of cypress wood. Make rooms in it, and cover it with tar inside and out.
This is how you must build it. The ark must be a hundred and fifty metres long, twenty-five metres wide and fifteen metres high.
Make a roof for it, leaving an opening of half a metre between the roof and the sides. Put a door in the side of the ark, and build it with a lower deck, a middle deck and an upper deck.
I am going to bring a flood of water on the earth to destroy every living thing under the sky that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will die.
But I will make my covenant with you, my solemn promise. You will go into the ark, you and your sons, your wife and your sons' wives with you.
You must bring into the ark two of every kind of living creature, a male and a female, to keep them alive with you.
Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you, so that they can stay alive.
Also take every kind of food that is eaten, and store it away as food for you and for them."
Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
